mappedContracts.statement: Implement current MCP authorization hardening for remote distribution, including issuer validation, credential isolation, scope step-up, client metadata documents, TLS, and least privilege.
acceptanceCriteria: Remote mode never shares Substack credentials across users, issuers, or publications.
Local stdio remains available without unnecessary remote auth complexity.
Smithery/hosted distribution has a documented credential model and privacy boundary.

mappedContracts.statement: Produce installable npm, MCPB, Docker/OCI, stdio, and Streamable HTTP distributions from one reproducible release.
acceptanceCriteria: Clean-room installation and Inspector tests pass for every format.
Registry metadata versions match package and release versions.
No distribution includes secrets, local state, capture artefacts, or repository-relative dependencies.

mappedContracts.statement: Create complete, synchronized metadata and build artefacts for the official MCP Registry, Glama, Smithery, mcp.so, and other relevant directories.
acceptanceCriteria: Include server.json, registry metadata, glama.json, Smithery metadata/config or MCPB manifest, well-known metadata where applicable, Docker/OCI labels, llms.txt, licence, privacy, security, installation examples, and tool annotations.
All metadata is generated or validated against the capability registry and release version.
